caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a brass or gold-colored oil lamp or candlestick with a wide, shallow circular base and a central stem that rises vertically. The base has a smooth, reflective surface with golden yellow and brown highlights that suggest metallic material. Attached to the side of the base is a curved, hook-like handle, which is rendered in the same gold tone as the rest of the object. The stem is slightly ornate, featuring gentle curves before it transitions into a rounded, urn-shaped reservoir at the top. At the very top, there is a small, raised opening with a blackened wick visible, indicating the lamp’s function. The background of the drawing is plain and light beige, with minimal shading and no additional objects present. Near the lower right corner of the paper, there is a handwritten signature or note that reads “Russell Gandle.”
title: Brass Oil Lamp
